table.name: customer_orders
table.summary: A transactional table recording details of customer orders, including status, shipping method, timing, and charges.

order_id.name: order_id
order_id.meaning: A unique identifier for a specific order record.

order_status_code.name: order_status_code
order_status_code.meaning: A code representing the current state of the order in the fulfillment lifecycle.

order_delivered_datetime.name: order_delivered_datetime
order_delivered_datetime.meaning: The timestamp when the order was successfully delivered to the customer (nullable if not yet delivered).
